name: financials_analyze_financial_transactions
description:
Analyzes Amazon SP-API financial transactions from neonpanel_iceberg.financial_transactions into the same summary_class / summary_subclass label set used by Amazon monthly payment summary reports.

Use this tool when the user wants to reconcile an uploaded payment/summary report against financial_transactions instead of Amazon statement settlement data.

Workflow:
1. Extract company_id and report_month from the uploaded summary/payment report
2. Call THIS tool with filters.company_id and filters.report_months, e.g. ['2026-04']
3. Compare the report's Income / Expenses / Tax / Transfers lines against summary_class + summary_subclass totals
4. Persist the comparison with financials_save_amazon_statement_reconciliation_result using reconciliation_source='financial_transactions'

Output: One row per summary class/subclass, including zero rows for expected categories that have no source lines. debits are negative source amounts, credits are positive source amounts, net_amount is debits + credits, and line_count is the number of source lines contributing to the row.

Common report_month format: YYYY-MM (for example, '2026-04'). If report_months is omitted, the tool scans all months for the company, so provide report_months for reconciliation work.

Knowledge base: https://help.neonpanel.com

filters.description: Compatibility alias for query.filters. Prefer query.filters.

sort.description: Compatibility alias for query.sort. Prefer query.sort.

limit.description: Compatibility alias for query.limit. Prefer query.limit.

query.description: Query envelope for financial transactions reconciliation analysis.

filters.description: Filters for the query. company_id is required; report_months is strongly recommended for reconciliation.

report_months.description: Monthly partitions to include, YYYY-MM, in the MARKETPLACE-LOCAL report timezone (US/CA=Pacific, UK=London, EU=CET, JP=Tokyo, AU=Sydney). Use one value for a monthly report, e.g. ['2026-03']. Matches Amazon's monthly summary period.

marketplaces.description: Optional filter by marketplace — accepts marketplace_name (e.g. 'Amazon.com', 'Amazon.co.uk') or marketplace_id (e.g. 'ATVPDKIKX0DER'). Amazon's unified reports are per-marketplace, so set this to match a country report (US = 'Amazon.com').

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start day (YYYY-MM-DD) filtered on posted_date_day (marketplace-local calendar day). Use with end_date for a day-range/daily report, e.g. start_date=end_date='2026-05-01'.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD) filtered on posted_date_day (marketplace-local calendar day).

summary_classes.description: Optional filter by summary class: Income, Expenses, Tax, Transfers. Case-insensitive exact match.

summary_subclasses.description: Optional substring filter by summary subclass, e.g. 'FBA transaction fees' or 'Product sales'. Case-insensitive.

field.description: Column to sort by. Default preserves the payment summary report order.

class_order.description: Display order of the top-level summary class.

subclass_order.description: Display order within the summary class.

summary_class.description: Summary class: Income, Expenses, Tax, or Transfers.

debits.description: Sum of negative source amounts for this subclass.

credits.description: Sum of positive source amounts for this subclass.

net_amount.description: Net amount for this subclass (debits + credits).

line_count.description: Number of source rows contributing to this subclass.
